summary.zh: agent-pack 的“旧运行时”回归测试只取早于被测提交的正式发布 tag：候选 tag（含指向被测提交的 -rc.N）不再被当作旧运行时，避免打 rc tag 后 Release 工作流的测试步骤失败。
summary.en: The agent-pack older-runtime regression test now takes only the latest official release tag strictly before the commit under test: candidate tags, including an -rc.N tag on that very commit, are no longer mistaken for an older runtime, so the Release workflow's test step no longer fails once an rc tag exists.
